articles.title: Asian Stocks Eye Rough Start After US Reversal: Markets Wrap - Bloomberg.com
articles.description: US stock-index futures advanced and Asian technology shares gained as Micron Technology Inc.’s upbeat forecast boosted sentiment toward the sector. Treasuries held their losses, while the dollar strengthened.
